events.title: Iberdrola launches 195MW Tâmega Norte wind farm in Portugal
events.body: The wind farm, part of the Tâmega Complex, is the first grid-connected wind-hydro hybrid project on the Iberian Peninsula.

events.title: Vestas secures 186 MW order from EDF power solutions North America
events.body: Vestas has secured a 186 MW order from EDF power solutions North America to supply wind turbines for the Forêt Domaniale wind project in Canada.

events.title: Vestas Wind Systems (CPSE:VWS) Valuation Check After New 70 MW Strazhitsa Order In Bulgaria

events.title: Vestas receives 70 MW order from Tessa Green Energy to deliver wind energy in Bulgaria
events.body: Vestas has received a 70 MW order from Tessa Green Energy to deliver more wind energy in Bulgaria.

events.title: Forêt Domaniale Wind Project secures financial close
events.body: The project’s financing, structured under the Green Loan Principles, comes from a consortium of lenders.

events.title: CWP Energy secures funding for Sanquhar II wind project
events.body: The 308MW Sanquhar II wind farm is backed by a $537.8m (£400m) agreement.
